title: 大みそかと年越し
subject_en: Flat colourful illustrations of New Year's Eve in Japan, each ONE object or scene centred, deep blue and red accents. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: 年越しそば・除夜の鐘・初日の出など、大みそかから元日の朝までの小物と場面を描いた12点です。年末のカードや案内に使えます。
items: a bowl of toshikoshi soba with a shrimp tempura and green onion
a temple bell with a wooden striker and a few snowflakes
a wall clock with both hands at twelve, no numbers
a family sitting in front of a TV with mandarin oranges, seen from behind
a night shrine approach with lanterns and a small crowd of silhouettes
the first sunrise over the sea with a pine tree in the foreground
a person wiping a window with a bucket and cloth
a blank greeting card with a gold border and a plum blossom
two cups raised together in a toast with sparkles
a pair of kadomatsu pine and bamboo decorations
a cat sitting in front of a soba bowl wearing a small scarf
fireworks over a night town roof with a crescent moon
